model_selection_note: Select one capable model release supported by the execution environment before the first agent assignment. Use that release for all three pilot roles unless the owner explicitly changes the configuration.
escalation_policy: Increase effort for consequential ambiguity, conflicting evidence, or integration conflicts within the assignment boundary; record changes and affected work. Do not substitute an unsupported model or effort setting silently.
actual_settings_policy: Record requested and actual model/effort separately. If the actual value is not exposed, record unknown with the reason rather than inferring it from this configuration.
execution_policy: One census agent executes at a time. This file records intended settings; it does not launch agents or prove that the runtime applied them.
